Test Case Name: SD-102: Verify inventory page shows title and six products with image, name, description, price and Add to cart
Preconditions:
1. Public demo site https://www.saucedemo.com/, logged in as standard_user (accepted usernames and the shared password are listed on the login page).
2. Inventory page displayed.
Test Case Steps:
1. Observe the page title.
2. Count the product tiles.
3. For each tile, check for image, name, description, price and an Add to cart button.
Expected Result:
1. Title reads "Products".
2. Six products are listed.
3. Every tile shows all five elements. The six products are Sauce Labs Backpack, Bike Light, Bolt T-Shirt, Fleece Jacket, Onesie and Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red).

Test Case Name: SD-102: Verify products with equal prices fall back to Name (A to Z) order (boundary - price tie)
Preconditions:
1. Public demo site https://www.saucedemo.com/, logged in as standard_user (accepted usernames and the shared password are listed on the login page).
2. Inventory page displayed.
3. Two products share the price $15.99: Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt and Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red).
Test Case Steps:
1. Select Price (low to high).
2. Note the order of the two $15.99 products.
3. Select Price (high to low).
4. Note the order of the two $15.99 products again.
Expected Result:
1. List reorders.
2. Bolt T-Shirt appears before Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Name A to Z fallback).
3. List reorders.
4. Bolt T-Shirt still appears before Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt. The tie order does not flip with the price direction.
